title: WhatsApp Lead Capture
description: An n8n workflow designed to turn a WhatsApp inquiry into structured lead details, qualify the request, and route follow-up actions.

steps: Extract structured fields and check qualification conditions.

title: Calendar AI Assistant
description: A Make scenario that searches Google Calendar, passes the results to an AI agent, and prepares a WhatsApp response.
note: Based on the supplied three-module Make blueprint. This is a design walkthrough, not a running booking service.
steps: Search events in a configured calendar.
Pass calendar context to the AI agent.
Send the agent response through the configured WhatsApp integration.

title: AI Content Routing
description: A Make workflow that receives a webhook, processes incoming items, routes requests, downloads supporting files, and passes AI output to Discord.
note: Based on the supplied Frankid blueprint: two routed file/AI/Discord branches. Private URLs, connection IDs and message data are excluded.
steps: Iterate over items and select a route.
Download a supporting file and run the configured AI agent.
Send the generated response to Discord.
